name: Gardenia Livings
paymentPlan: 20% down at sales launch, 20% during construction, 10% on handover, 50% post handover
overview: Gardenia Livings, a prestigious address at Arjan Dubailand, is brought to you by the renowned Safe Developers. This exclusive residential development boasts of an impressive collection of 1 & 2-bedroom apartments, integrated with a Golf Course right within the community. The grandeur of Gardenia Livings is encapsulated by the lush green views from the balconies and living rooms of every apartment. The interiors are designed with a sleek, modern aesthetic, featuring high-quality flooring and chic kitchen countertops. The building is designed to offer maximum comfort with a cooling efficiency system, superior acoustics, and optimal lighting.
